verdict.rationale: Undermind explicitly supports parallel full-text analysis 'across many papers at once' (docs-5) and offers a programmatic API for enterprise use (docs-17), suggesting some bulk automation capability. However, other cited actions like curating or starring papers are described as single-item actions, and there's no dedicated bulk-edit/export UI or batch-processing documentation beyond the parallel PDF reading feature. Missing for 10: documentation of a batch/bulk UI or API for operations like mass tagging, exporting, or curating many items simultaneously, and independent confirmation of bulk-scale performance.
